core_theorems: 16 principal claims accepted under stated hypotheses

claims.quantifier: every real length-two tensor and every quaternion probe
claims.result: exact value/residual coordinates and full insertion response
claims.proof_basis: Independent reading and algebraic review; not inferred from finite tests; see REPORT_JA.md.

claims.quantifier: all trace-free symmetric 3x3 residuals; fixed scalar linear samples
claims.proof_basis: Independent reading and algebraic review; not inferred from finite tests; see REPORT_JA.md.

claims.quantifier: every finite tensor length m>=1; all quaternion gap arguments
claims.boundary: formal external assays on tensor spaces; not an automatic declaration of Core admissibility or constant-size history memory
claims.proof_basis: Independent reading and algebraic review; not inferred from finite tests; see REPORT_JA.md.

claims.quantifier: any sets, compression and specified response
claims.proof_basis: Independent reading and algebraic review; not inferred from finite tests; see REPORT_JA.md.

claims.quantifier: symmetric trace-free matrices in every n>=2
claims.proof_basis: Independent reading and algebraic review; not inferred from finite tests; see REPORT_JA.md.

claims.quantifier: all finite graph paths and concatenations with specified unit-quaternion links
claims.result: transport, exact signature, inverse and vertex gauge covariance
claims.proof_basis: Independent reading and algebraic review; not inferred from finite tests; see REPORT_JA.md.

claims.quantifier: every real symmetric S,D in finite dimension
claims.result: orthogonal split, unique minimum generator, response pseudoinverse
claims.boundary: full spectral tracking uses constant multiplicities; eigenvalue drift retained separately
claims.proof_basis: Independent reading and algebraic review; not inferred from finite tests; see REPORT_JA.md.

claims.quantifier: all constant-multiplicity spectral first jets in R3
claims.result: unique tracking rule under common SO(3) equivariance; no linearity or norm axiom
claims.boundary: fails for extra directional input, multiplicity-splitting jets, or unqualified SO(4) extension
claims.proof_basis: Independent reading and algebraic review; not inferred from finite tests; see REPORT_JA.md.

claims.quantifier: all nonorthogonal real rank-one projection pairs in R3
claims.result: unique shortest real line rotation; no common-frame selector on all orthogonal pairs
claims.boundary: real formula versus arithmetic support; supplied short path versus unknown interpolation
claims.proof_basis: Independent reading and algebraic review; not inferred from finite tests; see REPORT_JA.md.

claims.quantifier: every admissible pair, reference and independent endpoint frames
claims.proof_basis: Independent reading and algebraic review; not inferred from finite tests; see REPORT_JA.md.

claims.quantifier: any target data with nontrivial stabilizer, single-valued invertible frame map
claims.proof_basis: Independent reading and algebraic review; not inferred from finite tests; see REPORT_JA.md.

claims.quantifier: every nonzero gap; sequence of valid stable spectral jets
claims.result: inverse-gap bound and no unrestricted continuous extension at collision
claims.proof_basis: Independent reading and algebraic review; not inferred from finite tests; see REPORT_JA.md.

claims.quantifier: all irreducible spins j=0,1/2,1,... and all residuals
claims.result: zero for j<1, injective for j>=1, explicit trace coefficient
claims.proof_basis: Independent reading and algebraic review; not inferred from finite tests; see REPORT_JA.md.

claims.quantifier: finite-dimensional smooth Hermitian couplings; positive inertia; all solutions
claims.result: norm, energy/work, axial angular momentum balances; local/global existence conditions
claims.proof_basis: Independent reading and algebraic review; not inferred from finite tests; see REPORT_JA.md.

claims.quantifier: every positive hbar, inertia and energy scale
claims.proof_basis: Independent reading and algebraic review; not inferred from finite tests; see REPORT_JA.md.

claims.quantifier: all smooth prescribed nondegenerate base metrics, nonzero phi, A independent of extra coordinate
claims.boundary: no background field-equation solution, spin or material coupling
claims.proof_basis: Independent reading and algebraic review; not inferred from finite tests; see REPORT_JA.md.

claims.quantifier: every finite m>=1, tensors in (Im H)^tensor m, all imaginary basis probe tuples
rank-one orthogonal projectors and tangent first jets in every finite n>=2
